_meta.orchestrator_policy: stable-live = per-value cross-run agreement >=99% on common values AND >=1 moved in both runs AND moved >= 2x disagreements (so movement is not explicable by run-to-run noise). Representative arm must be the strongest stable-live arm. Never-observed-live on a single carrier => withheld as underpowered. Movement that does not reproduce => withheld.
